title: Define cancellation witnesses
summary: Defined compiler-owned cancellation witness descriptors and derivation for additive zero and multiplicative one, resolving authority from canonical operation contracts, validating the cancellation correspondence, binding the witness to the complete canceled source span and same-owner survivor anchors, separating semantic value from presentation policy, and rejecting invented values, partial slots, mixed owners, and invalid anchors.
